premises.text: Goal is sustainable efficient supply chain by replacing single-use online packaging with reusable shippers
premises.evidence_span: looking to make the supply chain system more sustainable and efficient

premises.text: Sell to retailers: shipper fleet plus software used when fulfilling consumer orders
premises.evidence_span: We provide them with a fleet of our shippers and the access to our software. Then they use those shippers when they're filling orders for their consumers

premises.text: E-commerce growth left retailers and consumers overburdened by cardboard boxes seeking alternatives
premises.evidence_span: E-commerce grew much faster than any of us thought. And then we found ourselves surrounded by these boxes

premises.text: Shippers are designed in-house from diverted billboard vinyl with useful material properties
premises.evidence_span: we actually designed our own reusable shippers

premises.text: Larger participation improves efficiency via nearest-need redistribution of shippers
premises.evidence_span: the more people that buy into the program, the better and more efficient it becomes

value.text: Smart reusable packaging for retailer-to-consumer shipping

causal_links.evidence_span: make the supply chain system more sustainable and efficient

notes: Q&A format; interviewer content excluded. Thin/truncated pitch. Return-model fit for rental baby clothes treated as illustration inside retailer use, not a separate premise.
